dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in Japanese medical billing system
evidence: no COMP-3 usage, no EXEC SQL/CICS

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (shinryo-koui / medical procedure calculation and checking) - specifically rehabilitation and psychiatric care calculation checks for the JMA ORCA receipt system
purpose.summary: This program is a component of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that performs medical procedure (shinryo-koui) checking and calculation for rehabilitation, psychiatric care, and related billing categories. It validates treatment dates, counts, and billing rules including early rehabilitation, psychiatric hospitalization periods, and various H24.4 (Heisei 24 April) revision compliance checks. It is called as a subprogram within the larger ORCA billing system.

notable_features: 211 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
OCCURS tables for daily rehabilitation counts
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive flag area (FLG-AREA) with many condition flags
Version history spanning 2000-2012 with multiple revision entries
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, appearing as mojibake. Program name ORCSC80201204 follows JMA ORCA naming convention. The '1204' suffix likely indicates H24.4 (April 2012) revision. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 173936 bytes total; full program likely contains substantial procedure division logic not visible here.
